description: Cryptocurrency records from CoinGecko. Rankings, search and coin-profile runs emit coin records with live prices, market cap, rank, volume, supply, all-time highs/lows and period changes. Trending runs emit trending_coin, trending_nft, trending_category and trending_rwa records. Category runs emit coin_category records with market cap, volume, 24h change and the top three coins.

records.description: Dataset containing every emitted record. The recordType field identifies coin, trending_coin, trending_nft, trending_category, trending_rwa or coin_category.
records.title: CoinGecko records

title: CoinGecko Rankings, Trending & Categories Output
